verdicts.reason: The summary only names 'Language Trees and Zipping' (2002) as a starting point and says nothing about gzip, clustering by language, or the language tree.
It says cross-entropy quantifies 'how well a compression scheme performs in a different context', matching a code optimized for one distribution used on another.
KL divergence is mentioned as 'wastefulness of suboptimal codes', but the summary never says cross-entropy is minimized when Q equals P or that the minimum is the entropy.
It says pre-training involves models 'trained to minimize this cross-entropy loss'.
Distillation is only named as another place cross-entropy is minimized; the summary does not say a small model trains against a larger model's full distribution.
